hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In a binary hierarchical structure, consider any path connecting two nodes.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: At each node, compute the maximum gain obtainable from its left and right subtrees.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Update the global maximum path sum with node.val + left_gain + right_gain.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Post-order tree traversal visits each node once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating paths pairwise takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion stack depth is bounded by tree height h.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computes one-way subtree gains while updating the two-way path maximum.
